messages:
Tom (AE): Handing off Meridian Labs - signed Dedicated + Private (VPC) eval. Trial ends in 9 days. They need SSO, peering, and a go-live perf check. Procurement flagged strict monthly cap and wants usage alerting.
Rosa (CSM): Thanks Tom. Can you share Okta metadata and the procurement contact? Any performance SLOs?
Tom (AE): Okta: https://meridian.okta.com/app/saml/meta.xml. Contact: procurement@meridianlabs.com. SLO: p50 <100ms for short prompts; expected burst ~1200 rps. Also wants per-route cost visibility.
SetupBot: Ticket #CS-5012 created for Meridian provisioning.
Derek (Support): I'll run baseline staging tests. Need CIDR and peering type (route vs. static).
Sam (Eng): For Dedicated Private: outbound 443 to control plane, 9000 for internal metrics. Recommend /28 for NAT. If they want on-prem package we'll need certs and rotate keys every 90 days.
Rosa (CSM): Action owners: Tom - confirm Okta & procurement intro; Sam - draft VPC peering runbook + terraform snippet; Derek - run perf baseline and attach logs; Rosa - set renewal alert and own cost mitigation plan.
Tom (AE): Intro sent to procurement and infra. Note: contract auto-renews unless flagged 30 days prior. Procurement wants a 45-day budget review.
Derek (Support): Baseline `wrk -t4 -c150 -d30s http://staging/meridian` p50 98ms p95 220ms. Will rerun after Sam's kernel tweaks.
Sam (Eng): Trying quantized kernel + prefix cache on staging tonight. Expect p95 ~150ms. Snapshot ts 1769104000.
Rosa (CSM): Customer worried about cost spikes during burst. I'll propose rate-limits + soft quotas in Console and document expected cost at committed tier. Filing FR for per-route cost insights.
Tom (AE): Heads up: missing the 9-day window could push billing start and increase churn risk. Prioritize SSO & perf. :warning:
Derek (Support): Acknowledged. I'll mark #CS-5012 P1 and update with logs.
Sam (Eng): Run complete after snapshot - p95 now ~145ms. Pushed notes to ticket.
Rosa (CSM): Scheduling a check-in Wed 11am PT to confirm SSO and perf. I'll send invite and include procurement. Also will capture onboarding notes into playbook for Dedicated+VPC patterns. :memo:
